metric.why: Water is the constraint communities notice first. Evaporative cooling trades electricity for water, so a low PUE can hide a high WUE, and permitting fights increasingly turn on this number.
metric.target: Operators using little or no evaporative cooling report WUE near zero; water-cooled designs in hot climates run substantially higher.
metric.formula: Annual site water use in liters / IT energy in kWh
metric.definition: Liters of water consumed by the facility, chiefly for evaporative cooling, per kilowatt-hour of IT energy delivered.
